sentiment.rationale: The document reports Q4 2024 GAAP and Adjusted EPS of $2.41, near the high end of the company's own guidance range of $1.85 to $2.45, and full-year EPS of $8.86 within the original guidance range. However, forward guidance for FY2025 is cautious: net sales growth around 1%, comparable sales around flat, and EPS of $8.80 to $9.80, which is essentially flat to slightly down from the $8.86 reported for FY2024. Management explicitly flags 'ongoing consumer uncertainty,' 'tariff uncertainty,' and expects 'meaningful year-over-year profit pressure' in Q1 2025. The guidance is not raised; it is held with a cautious tone and explicit downside risks, resulting in a slightly negative score.

summary.revenue: Q4 2024 Net Sales of $30.9 billion, down 3.1% vs. $31.9 billion in Q4 2023 (which had an extra week). Full-year 2024 Net Sales of $106.6 billion, down 0.8% vs. $107.4 billion in 2023. On a 52-week comparable basis, full-year Net Sales increased approximately 1%.
summary.eps: Q4 2024 GAAP and Adjusted EPS of $2.41, compared with $2.98 in Q4 2023 (down 19.3%). Full-year 2024 GAAP and Adjusted EPS of $8.86, compared with $8.94 in 2023 (down 0.9%). On a 52-week comparable basis, full-year EPS grew nearly 3%.
summary.guidance: Full-year 2025: Net Sales growth around 1%, comparable sales growth around flat, modest increase in operating margin rate, effective tax rate 23-24%, GAAP and Adjusted EPS of $8.80 to $9.80. Management expects meaningful year-over-year profit pressure in Q1 2025.
summary.margin: Q4 2024 gross margin rate 26.2% vs. 26.6% in Q4 2023. Full-year 2024 gross margin rate 28.2% vs. 27.5% in 2023. Q4 2024 operating income margin rate 4.7% vs. 5.8% in Q4 2023. Full-year 2024 operating income margin rate 5.2% vs. 5.3% in 2023.
key_risks: Ongoing consumer uncertainty and declining consumer confidence affecting discretionary spending.
Tariff uncertainty and potential impact on costs and consumer demand.
Small decline in February Net Sales, with soft topline performance due to cold weather and declining consumer confidence.
Expected meaningful year-over-year profit pressure in Q1 2025 due to tariff uncertainty, start-up costs, and timing of expenses.
Higher digital fulfillment and supply chain costs, and higher promotional and clearance markdown rates in Q4 2024.
key_opportunities: Strong Q4 comparable sales growth of 1.5%, driven by traffic and digital performance.
Digital comparable sales grew 8.7% in Q4, with Same-Day delivery powered by Target Circle 360 growing more than 25%.
Beauty delivered mid-single digit comparable sales growth for the full year, with share gains.
Cost savings of more than $2 billion over the last two years from ongoing efficiency efforts.
Target Plus marketplace growing at double-digit pace, expected to reach $5 billion in GMV within five years.
Roundel media business delivering nearly $2 billion in value, with potential to double in size over five years.
Target Circle 360 membership quadrupled since launch, with potential to more than triple over three years.
Expectation to drive more than $15 billion in revenue growth over the next five years.
